description: Make printable math worksheets with an answer key. Pick a skill (one of the site’s 60 ready skills, e.g. addition-within-10, addition-within-20, 2-digit-addition-without-regrouping, 2-digit-addition-with-regrouping, 3-digit-addition-with-regrouping, subtraction-within-10, times tables, fractions, telling time, money, place value, number bonds…), or build your own arithmetic sheet with operation and number ranges. Up to 20 sheets, each with different problems.

answer_key.description: Answer keys at the end (on by default).

decoration.description: A themed border with matching pictures, drawn around the sheet: "line" for a plain border, "none" for nothing, or a theme such as halloween, christmas, thanksgiving, spring, dinosaurs, space, ocean, animals, birthday, back-to-school (95 themes; find_printables shows a theme’s name). Leave out for no border.

dyslexia_font.description: Print in OpenDyslexic, a typeface some readers with dyslexia find easier.

first_numbers.description: The range of the first number, [min, max], e.g. [10, 99] for two digits.

operation.description: Own arithmetic: add, sub, mul, div, addsub (mixed + and −) or all (mixed).

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

regrouping.description: Addition and subtraction: any, none (no carrying or borrowing) or always.

second_numbers.description: The range of the second number, [min, max]; for times tables [7, 7] gives only ×7.

seed.description: Which random version to make. Leave out for a fresh one; pass the seed from an earlier result to keep that version while changing other settings.

skill.description: A ready skill (the math worksheet pages of the site). Leave out to use operation and ranges.

title.description: The title printed at the top of the sheet, e.g. "Two-Digit Addition". Keep it short.

name: make_math_worksheet

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Math worksheet
